metadata.intro: The Astrophysics and Cosmology hub explores the physical laws governing the evolution of the universe, from the internal mechanics of stars to the large-scale curvature of the 4D manifold.

pillars.title: 1. Stellar Physics & The Lifecycle of Matter
pillars.narrative: Examines the mechanisms governing the birth, stability, and energy production of stars within the subatomic manifold.

pillars.title: 2. High-Energy Plasma & Fluid Dynamics
pillars.narrative: Investigates the behavior of gas, magnetic fields, and shocks in the interstellar and intergalactic medium.

pillars.title: 3. Extreme Gravity & Compact Objects
pillars.narrative: Details the physics of gravitational collapse and the localized curvature of spacetime surrounding compact remnants.

pillars.title: 4. Global Cosmology & The Spacetime Metric
pillars.narrative: Explores the large-scale geometry, expansion history, and the dark constituents that dictate the evolution of the 4D Block Universe.
